concern: بنالیں (subjunctive of banaana) is written "banaliin" (long-ee nasal); ADR 0005 R2 requires nasal verb forms to stay single-vowel ("len" family), and the same verb is correctly "len" elsewhere in this surah (17:93 "padh len").
suggestion: Kya beton ke liye to Allah ne tumhein chhaant liya aur khud apne liye farishton ko ladkiyan banalen? Be-shak tum bahut bada bol bol rahe ho.

concern: سمجھیں (subjunctive of samajhna) is written "samjhein"; ADR 0005 R2 requires the single-vowel nasal form "samjhen", as used for this verb class elsewhere in the corpus.
suggestion: Aur un ke dilon par hum ne parde daal diye hain ke woh use samjhen aur un ke kaanon mein bojh, aur jab tu sirf Allah hi ka zikr us ki tauheed ke saath, is Quran mein karta hai to woh rogardaani karte peeth pher kar bhaag khade hote hain.

concern: دیکھیں (subjunctive of dekhna) is written "Dekhein"; ADR 0005 R2 requires the single-vowel nasal form "Dekhen".
suggestion: Dekhen to sahi, aap ke liye kya kya misaalen bayan karte hain, pas woh bahak rahe hain. Ab to raah paana un ke bas mein nahi raha.

concern: پوچھیں (subjunctive of poochhna) is written "poochhein"; ADR 0005 R2 requires the single-vowel nasal form "poochhen" (the corpus's dominant spelling, 2:1 over "poochhein").
suggestion: Ya koi aur aisi khilqat jo tumhare dilon mein bahut hi sakht maloom ho, phir woh poochhen ke kaun hai jo dobaara hamari zindagi lautaaye? Aap jawab de den ke wahi Allah jis ne tumhein awwal baar paida kiya, is par woh apne sar hila hila kar aap se daryaaft karenge ke achha yeh hai kab? To aap jawab de den ke kya ajab ke woh (saa-at) qareeb hi aan lagi ho.

concern: دیں appears twice meaning "gave" (سواریاں دیں, روزیاں دیں), the same past-tense construction the owner ruled on at 45:17 (Q21): write "dein", not "din" (which reads as "day"). Both instances here are still "din".
suggestion: Yaqeenan hum ne aulaad-e-Aadam ko badi izzat di aur unhein khushki aur tari ki sawaariyan dein aur unhein paakeeza cheezon ki roziyan dein aur apni bahut si makhlooq par unhein fazeelat ata farmaayi.

concern: گھڑ گھڑا لیں (subjunctive of lena) is written "ghad ghad lein"; ADR 0005 R2 requires the single-vowel nasal form "ghad ghad len".
suggestion: Yeh log aap ko is wahi se jo hum ne aap par utaari hai bahkaana chaahte ke aap is ke siwa kuch aur hi hamare naam se ghad ghad len, tab to aap ko yeh log apna wali dost bana lete.

concern: کرلیں (subjunctive of kar lena) is written "karlein"; ADR 0005 R2 requires the single-vowel nasal form "karlen" (the corpus's dominant spelling, 8:1 over "karlein").
suggestion: Aur agar hum chaahen to jo wahi aap ki taraf hum ne utaari hai sab salab karlen, phir aap ko is ke liye hamare muqaable mein koi himaayati mayassar na aaske.

concern: چاہیں (subjunctive of chahna) is written "chaahein"; ADR 0005 R2 requires the single-vowel nasal form "chaahen", used correctly for the same verb elsewhere in this surah (17:18, 17:86 both have "chaahen").
suggestion: Keh dijiye ke agar tamaam insaan aur kull jinnat mil kar is Quran ke misl laana chaahen to un sab se is ke misl laana na-mumkin hai go woh (aapas mein) ek doosre ke madadgaar bhi ban jaayen.
